safety_invariants.name: reset_vector_jump
safety_invariants.description: TSL-BOOT (`boot.payload.bin` @ 0x002642) verifies `*(uint8_t*)0x08008000 == 0x6F` before jumping into runtime firmware.

safety_invariants.name: startup_boot_flag_clear
safety_invariants.expected_asm: c.li a5, 0x10; sb a5, 9(sp); c.addi4spn a0, sp, 8; sb zero, 0xc(sp); c.jal 0x1d92
safety_invariants.description: Runtime startup routine 0x001E48 clears the boot/upgrade request byte at 0x08077B04 (`0xc(sp)`) via 0x001D92 so the module boots into runtime normally.

patches.title: Ignore Remote Deauthorization Command (0xAE)
patches.summary: Prevents BLE command 0xAE from wiping the persistent 16-bit activation token at flash 0x08077B02 or scheduling the 1000 ms deauthorization lockout timer.
patches.rationale: When the legacy WeChat Mini Program receives state:1 from iffrc.com, it sends BLE command 0xAE with the 14-byte UID. In stock firmware, 0x00BD8A validates the UID (0x12D4), checks 0x01A6, and if authorized (a0 != 0) calls 0x1E26(0) at 0x00BDAA to overwrite flash 0x08077B02 with 0x0000 and calls 0x5EF6 at 0x00BDAE to schedule deauthorization. Replacing `c.beqz a0, 0xc` (11c5) at 0x00BDA6 with `c.j 0xc` (31a0) unconditionally jumps to the 0x00BDB2 ACK reply builder (`0xAE 01`), preserving flash and RAM authorization state.
safety_notes: 2-byte RVC in-place branch replacement; no function size or stack change.
Eliminates unnecessary flash erase/write cycles on 0x08077B00 when 0xAE is received.
Preserves normal 0xAE [0x01] BLE acknowledgment so legacy apps do not hang.

sites.description: Unconditionally branch over `c.li a0, 0; jal 0x1e26; jal 0x5ef6` to the 0xAE ACK reply at 0x00BDB2.

patches.title: Always Set Local Authorization Flag (0xd3(gp) = 1)
patches.summary: Forces the flash activation-token verifier at 0x001360 to write 1 into 0xd3(gp) on boot even if flash 0x08077B02 was previously erased/zeroed.
patches.function_context: Activation token verifier 0x001360..0x00138A (called at boot from 0x001E78)
patches.rationale: Function 0x001360 reads the stored 16-bit token at 0x08077B02 via 0x1DBA, compares it against the local CRC-16 token from 0x1316 (seed 0x5AA5, poly 0x1021), converts the equality result via `seqz a0, a0` at 0x001380, and writes `sb a0, 0xd3(gp)` at 0x001384. `0xd3(gp)` has only one reader (`0x0001A6: lbu a0, 0xd3(gp)`). Replacing `seqz a0, a0` (`13351500`) at 0x001380 with `addi a0, zero, 1` (`13051000`) ensures `0xd3(gp)` is always 1 without flash writes.
safety_notes: 4-byte RV32I instruction replacement; does not alter flash contents at 0x08077B00.
Safe companion to `ignore_server_deauth_0xae` for modules already deauthorized in flash.

sites.description: Force authorization flag a0 = 1 prior to `sb a0, 0xd3(gp)` at 0x001384.

patches.title: Make 0xA6 00 Cleanly Disable Media Pulse Scheduler & AP Auto-Restore
patches.summary: Routes the tail of the `0xA6 00` handler (`0x00C526`) into the `0xA1` scheduler disable path (`0x00C510`) after clearing `0x2000BEF1`, so `0xA6 00` stops both AP auto-restore and the `0xE4E4` autonomous media pulse timer.
patches.rationale: In stock firmware, `0xA6` (`0x00BFB4`) loads `a5 = lbu 0(s0)` and branches on `a5 == 0` (`0x00BFB8`) to `0x00C522`. `0x00C522` calls `0x25F6` (which only clears the RAM flag `0x2000BEF1`) and at `0x00C526` jumps to `0x00BCBA` without stopping the `0xE4E4` media pulse scheduler (`0x18c(gp)`). Because `s0` is callee-saved and still points to the `0xA6 00` payload (`0(s0) == 0`), patching `0x00C526` from `j -0x86c` (`-> 0x00bcba`) to `j -0x16` (`-> 0x00c510`) chains `0x25F6` directly into `0x00C510` (`lbu a0, 0(s0); c.li a1, 1; snez a0, a0; jal 0x00e4e4; j 0x00bcba`), stopping timers 1 & 4 and persisting the disabled state.
safety_notes: 0x00BFB8 (`beqz a5, 0x56a -> 0x00c522`) is the sole branch targeting 0x00C522.
s0 is preserved across `jal 0x25f6` (`0x25F6` only touches caller-saved a0/a5/ra).

sites.description: After `jal 0x25f6` at 0x00C522, jump to 0x00C510 to invoke `0xE4E4(0, 1)` before exiting to 0x00BCBA.

patches.title: Responsive Media Pulse Timing Preset (1500 ms Base + 0..500 ms Jitter)
patches.summary: Adjusts the mode 0/1 & AP/FSD (`0xF`) media pulse timing in `0x00E3E6` from 2000 ms + 0..1000 ms jitter down to 1500 ms + 0..500 ms jitter.
patches.rationale: In `0x00E3E6`, when `settings[3] & 0xF` is `0`, `1`, or `0xF` (AP/FSD-gated mode, mapped to `s0 = 1` at `0x00E414`), `0x00E424` loads the jitter modulus `0x3E9` (1001 ms -> 0..1000 ms) into `a5` and `0x00E42C` loads the base pulse interval `0x7D0` (2000 ms) into `s0`. Updating `0x00E424` to `0x1F5` (501 ms) and `0x00E42C` to `0x5DC` (1500 ms) provides a faster 1.5 s..2.0 s cadence.
safety_notes: Both constants fit in standard signed 12-bit RV32I `addi` immediates.
Downstream tick conversion (`(ms * 1000) / 625` at 0x00E44C..0x00E454) is unchanged.

sites.description: Set random jitter modulus to 501 ms (0..500 ms) for mode 0/1/0xF.
Set base pulse interval to 1500 ms (1.5 s) for mode 0/1/0xF.

patches.title: Compact Media Pulse Timing Preset (1000 ms Base + 0..250 ms Jitter)
patches.summary: Adjusts the mode 0/1 & AP/FSD (`0xF`) media pulse timing in `0x00E3E6` from 2000 ms + 0..1000 ms jitter to 1000 ms + 0..250 ms jitter.
patches.rationale: Sets the `0x00E424` jitter modulus to `0xFB` (251 ms -> 0..250 ms) and the `0x00E42C` base interval to `0x3E8` (1000 ms) for a tight 1.0 s..1.25 s window.

sites.description: Set random jitter modulus to 251 ms (0..250 ms) for mode 0/1/0xF.
Set base pulse interval to 1000 ms (1.0 s) for mode 0/1/0xF.

patches.title: Shorten Scroll-Wheel Timer-4 Followup Delay (50 ms -> 25 ms)
patches.summary: Reduces the timer-4 scroll-wheel pulse followup delay at `0x00E468` from 80 ticks (`0x50` = 50 ms) to 40 ticks (`0x28` = 25 ms).
patches.rationale: At the end of `0x00E3E6`, timer 4 (`a1 = 4`) is armed with `a2 = 0x50` (80 BLE OS ticks at 0.625 ms/tick = 50 ms). Replacing `addi a2, zero, 0x50` (`13060005`) with `addi a2, zero, 0x28` (`13068002`) halves the timer-4 delay to 25 ms.
safety_notes: Independent of `pulse_interval_preset`; can be combined with any interval preset.

sites.description: Arm timer 4 with 40 ticks (25 ms) instead of 80 ticks (50 ms).

patches.title: Custom 0xA0 Firmware Version Tag (0x16 / V1.6.00)
patches.summary: Populates `status[2]` (`firmwareVersion`) in the `0xA0` status response builder (`0x00AF6C`) with `0x16` (`V1.6.00`) instead of reading `0x10` (`V1.0.00`) from flash `0x08077B01`.
patches.rationale: Although the vendor cloud metadata labeled the archived runtime `fw_ver_new=5376` (`0x1500` = `V1.5.00`), the binary's startup routine at `0x001E5A`/`0x001E6A` writes `0x10` (`V1.0.00`) to `0x08077B01`, and `0x00AF6C` loads that byte via `0x00AFB6: lbu a5, 0xd(sp)` (`8347d100`) before storing `status[2]` at `0x00AFC4: sb a5, 0x16(sp)`. Replacing the 4-byte `lbu a5, 0xd(sp)` at `0x00AFB6` with `addi a5, zero, 0x16` (`93076001`) makes `0xA0` report `0x16` (`V1.6.00`) without modifying `0x001E48` or triggering an extra flash erase/write to `0x08077B00` on boot.
safety_notes: Leaves startup flash-init routine `0x001E48..0x001E7C` untouched, avoiding extra flash wear.
Supports any version byte 0x01..0x7F (e.g., 0x15 -> V1.5.00, 0x16 -> V1.6.00).

sites.description: Load immediate firmware version byte 0x16 (V1.6.00) into a5 for `sb a5, 0x16(sp)`.

patches.title: Allow Steering-Wheel Angle Triggers (0xAA..0xB0) in All Gears When AP Is Inactive
patches.summary: Nops the Drive-gear-only branch (`0x008100: bne a0, a5, 0x16`) in `0x0080EC` so offline CAN `0x129` steering-wheel angle triggers (`0xAA..0xB0`) can fire in Park, Reverse, Neutral, and Drive while retaining the Autopilot-inactive safety gate.
patches.rationale: In stock firmware, `0x00811E` decodes CAN `0x129` (`ID129SteeringAngle`) and dispatches triggers `0xAA` (return to center `[-6.0 deg, +6.0 deg]`), `0xAB..0xAD` (left turn `>20 deg`, `>45 deg`, `>90 deg`), and `0xAE..0xB0` (right turn `>20 deg`, `>45 deg`, `>90 deg`) through `0x0080EC(trigger_id)`. `0x0080EC` checks `0x0272()` (vehicle awake), then checks `0x4D14() == 4` (Drive gear) via `0x008100: bne a0, a5, 0x16` (`631bf500`), and then checks `0x2AA8() == 0` (Autopilot inactive) before jumping to `0xE310(trigger_id)`. Because of `0x008100`, offline steering-angle rules are blocked in Park (`1`), Reverse (`2`), and Neutral (`3`). Replacing `631bf500` at `0x008100` with `13000000` (`nop`) enables steering-angle automations in Park/Reverse/Neutral/Drive while preserving both the vehicle-awake gate (`0x0080F4`) and the Autopilot-inactive gate (`0x008104: jal 0x2aa8; c.bnez a0, 0xe`).
safety_notes: 4-byte RV32I in-place instruction replacement (`bne` -> `nop`); no stack or size change.
Retains `0x008104: jal 0x2aa8; c.bnez a0, 0xe` so steering triggers remain suppressed whenever Autopilot/Autosteer is active.
Retains `0x0080F4: jal 0x0272; c.beqz a0, 0x1e` so triggers do not fire when the vehicle is asleep.

sites.description: Bypass `gear != 4` branch in `0x0080EC` while keeping `0x0272` (awake) and `0x2AA8` (AP inactive) checks intact.
